title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Premium Rates and Cargo Category Uplift Percentages
content:
This tariff card lists, tier by tier, the premium rate and the cargo category uplifts used across `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims`.

## What each figure means

- **Premium rate.** The premium, or ad valorem charge, of a tier expressed as a percentage of the insured value, stated to two decimal places.
- **Dangerous goods uplift.** The percentage by which a tier's premium is increased when the covered cargo is dangerous goods.
- **Reefer uplift.** The percentage by which a tier's premium is increased when the covered cargo is refrigerated cargo.
- **Out-of-gauge uplift.** The percentage by which a tier's premium is increased when the covered cargo is out of gauge.

General cargo attracts no uplift under any tier.

## Tariff card

| Tier | Premium rate (percent of insured value) | Dangerous goods uplift (percent) | Reefer uplift (percent) | Out-of-gauge uplift (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AHL Standard Carrier Liability` | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| `AHL Declared Value Liability` | 1.50 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| `AHL CargoCare Essential` | 0.12 | 0 | 0 | 10 |
| `AHL CargoCare Plus` | 0.18 | 0 | 20 | 10 |
| `AHL CargoCare Premium` | 0.25 | 25 | 15 | 10 |
| `AHL CargoCare Total` | 0.35 | 40 | 10 | 10 |

## Reading the card

- *Which uplift applies to an out-of-gauge shipment under `AHL CargoCare Premium`?* The out-of-gauge column shows 10 percent for that tier.
- *Which uplift applies to refrigerated cargo under `AHL CargoCare Plus`?* The reefer column shows 20 percent.
- *What rate stands against the declared value tier?* 1.50 percent of the insured value.
- *Does general cargo ever carry an uplift?* No; the card has no general cargo column because no tier applies one.
